content: Claude Code headless/SDK: hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart/SessionEnd) fire identically in headless mode; --resume needs the same working directory or a persisted SessionStore (S3/Redis/Postgres) plus session_id to pick up mid-task. Large parallel subagent fan-outs (~20 concurrent) risk hitting Anthropic API rate limits. Subagents get a fresh context window with only the parent's prompt string as input -- nothing else carries over -- and their output is lost unless the parent explicitly captures/relays it. A resume/session-picker interactive prompt appearing when starting headless in a directory with prior sessions can silently block unattended automation.
